websocket.description: Open it with the HTTP upgrade described by the OpenAPI operation connectWebSocket, which owns authentication, Origin, and the connection_id and sequence_number resume parameters. Every frame is one JSON text message. The server sends events, each with a sequence that increases by one; the client sends commands, each with a sequence it chooses, and the reply carries that sequence back. Clients ignore an event name they do not know.

websocket.title: WebSocket connection
